osteoclasts.7, 14, 20, 28, 41 Bisphosphonates approved by the FDA
and TPD for preventing and treating postmenopausal osteo-
porosis, osteoporosis in men, and glucocorticoid-induced
osteoporosis in both sexes are alendronate, risedronate, and
ibandronate. Bisphosphonates are considered the ﬁ rst choice 
for the pharmacological treatment of osteoporosis in men.28
Bisphosphonates have been shown to decrease bone turnover 
and increase bone mass in the lumbar spine and hip by as
much as 8% and 6%, respectively, and to reduce spine and hip 
fracture risk by as much as 50%.7, 28, 38 Th e bisphosphonates
diﬀ er from each other in terms of their potency, ability to
inhibit bone resorption, toxicity, and dosing regimen.
Bisphosphonates are poorly absorbed by the gastrointestinal
tract and should only be taken ﬁ rst thing in the morning on an 
empty stomach with at least one cup of plain water. Th ey are
